owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (design: the face, the verbs, the library, the parts inventory; disposition of what the librarian learns into the intention layer)
intention: The librarian as a device — db_domain's first real tenant and the owner of the graph trees. FIRST FACE (the current goal): a chatbot — learning always, summarizing when asked. A query resolves by traversing the trees (cheap, no inference); on a MISS the LLM is asked for the NODES that let the graph resolve — never the answer — so the answer always comes from structure and re-asking is a graph walk, not a second inference. Law 1 as a runtime mechanism.
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'in future we can ask the librarian to spend a few days researching a topic ... and it can come back with a summary that we can also ask deeper questions from. And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' Same day, the frame: 'the goal is only improving CC not hiding it yet' — the cocoon stays distant; the librarian improves CC, it does not wrap it. The full design record: CairnCommons/notes/held-librarian.json (his parts inventory, the LIBRARY room at the RATIFIED address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/, the three verbs: learn / learn+summarize / learn+summarize-by-X-time).
traces_to: Law 1 — the core loop IS the law as runtime: every answered question becomes structure; the settled resolves by walk, the resolver is spent only on the novel
Law 3 — a node provided by the LLM is a hypothesis at birth; it earns tenure the way probes do
Law 6 — the librarian OWNS the graph trees; db_domain's owner-gate is the physics under every write
telos aim 1 (inference compilation) and aim 4 (think like Akien) — every /sorted has been one distillation by hand; this device is that move, compiled

state: code-seam@v1: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [BUILDME] -> PROVEME -> LEARNME -> PROVED   (cursor at BUILDME 2026-07-27; the device builds stone-wise — children carry the stones; the parent rests at BUILDME until the face is whole)
gates: each child stone carries its own proof gate; the parent's PROVEME is the composed face: a question answered from structure, a MISS folded in, a re-ask resolving by walk alone.
falsifier: wrong-shape signals: answers coming from inference when the graph already holds the structure (the core loop bypassed — a chatbot wearing a librarian's charter); the graph growing without provenance (nodes nobody can trace — fabricated attribution at deposit scale); the summary becoming a document the graph forgets (the transducer detached from the trees).
